# vergeio_tenant_recipes (Data Source)

Lists tenant recipes and the questions each recipe asks at deploy time. `filter_name` keeps an exact recipe name. Set `catalog_id` or `catalog_name` to limit the list to one catalog. The same recipe name in two catalogs is two rows unless a catalog is set.

Pass `recipes[0].id` to [`vergeio_tenant_recipe_instance`](../resources/tenant_recipe_instance.md) as `recipe_id`. `questions` is in form order. `name` is the answers key. `type` `disksize` is bytes. `type` `bool` accepts `true`, `false`, `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `1`, or `0`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vergeio_tenant_recipes" "trial" {
  catalog_name = "Tenants"
  filter_name  = "30-Day Trial (POC)"
}

output "trial_recipe_id" {
  value = data.vergeio_tenant_recipes.trial.recipes[0].id
}
```
